mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_account (account_code, account_name, system_name, username, password, auth_type, auth_config, status) VALUES (#{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{systemName}, #{username}, #{password}, #{authType}, #{authConfig}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM test_account
AND system_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{systemName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE test_account SET status = 2, lock_until = #{lockUntil}, last_used_time = NOW() WHERE account_code = #{accountCode} AND (status = 1 OR (status = 2 AND lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until < NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_account WHERE account_code = #{accountCode} AND (status = 1 OR (status = 2 AND lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until < NOW())) LIMIT 1
